_comment: Known spec/data disagreements accepted at the time of recording. spec_check.py fails on anything NOT listed here. Remove an entry when the underlying spec is fixed, to lock the fix in.

notes.C3DVRTrophy::FOURCC_OWNED_BY_ANOTHER_CLA: Heuristic, not a real conflict. _gam_classids.tsv's last column is `class_or_nearby_string` -- whatever class string sits near the registration site, not the registering class. 3TRO's neighbour is C3DTrophy(); the spec's RTTI name is C3DVRTrophy. No separate C3DTrophy spec exists, and the native registry binds 3TRO to the VR trophy.
notes.C3DNeutron::FOURCC_OWNED_BY_ANOTHER_CLAS: Same heuristic. 3NEU's neighbouring string is C3DSprite(), but the spec cites registration at 00432a53 and the table's site for 3NEU is exactly 00432a53 -- the spec is right and the nearby-string column is the weak signal.
